major: Big new features or a change to how the app works.
bugfix: Fixes for things that didn't work as they should.
hotfix: An urgent fix, out soon after a release.

entries.title: kue is out
items: Audio, video, OSC and MIDI cues
Fades with curve presets and a curve editor
Timecode in (MTC and LTC), timecode out, and a built-in clock
Phone remote with a QR code
Show mode

entries.title: Virtual outputs
items: New output type: Virtual (Windows). There's no window; the picture goes straight to other apps over Spout, so mapp, lynk, Resolume, TouchDesigner and anything else with Spout can pick it up
Add one in Output setup › Add output › Virtual output. It shows up as "KYNETYK vyz" plus the output's name
Virtual outputs start when you go live, the same as window outputs
vyz now shows up in lynk with its virtual outputs, ready to patch into mapp

entries.title: vyz is out
items: Clip grid with layers as rows, banks, groups and an A/B group crossfade
Video, images, cameras, generators and ISF shaders
22 effects with envelopes on every setting
Free, beat sync and timecode playback
Window outputs cut into layered slices, and recording to file
MIDI and OSC learn, Launchpad and APC presets, MIDI clock in, MTC out and a phone remote

entries.title: mapp is out
items: Quad, mesh and smooth mesh surfaces with masks, feathering and colour controls
Split view: pick the part of the source each surface uses on the left, warp it on the right
Media, generators, ISF shaders, cameras, capture cards and window or screen capture
KYNETYK sources: pick up virtual outputs from vyz and rakk (or any Spout app) straight from the GPU, with no window to capture (Windows)
lynk can patch virtual outputs into mapp's Source 1 to 4
Outputs with edge blending, test patterns and alignment grids
Cues with fades, fired from GO, timecode (follows kode), MIDI or OSC

entries.title: Virtual output
items: New Virtual button (Windows): sends rakk's output to other apps over Spout with no window, so mapp, vyz, lynk and other Spout apps can pick it up as "KYNETYK rakk"
It follows the Res setting and comes back on next time if you left it on
rakk now shows up in lynk while the virtual output is on

entries.title: Installers for every platform
items: Windows, macOS and Linux installers are all built for each release

entries.title: rakk is out
items: Two layers of live shader visuals, mixed and played with eight faders each
LFO, beat, audio and random modulation on any fader
Scenes that morph on the bar
Master effects chain
Import .frag and .glsl shaders, with faders suggested for you
MIDI learn, a full-screen output window and recording to file

entries.title: Virtual outputs
items: Video patches use the exact names apps give their virtual outputs, so patching vyz or rakk into mapp just works

entries.title: lynk is out
items: Finds every KYNETYK app running on this machine or your network
Patch, Matrix and Rack views
Clock master from any app, tap tempo or MIDI clock
Out of suite: NDI, Spout/Syphon, MIDI clock, Art-Net timecode and OSC
Save routing as .lynk shows

entries.title: kode is out
items: Readout, Streams and Triggers views
Generate, read (LTC, MTC, Art-Net), run on the computer clock or follow another stream
Triggers that fire OSC or MIDI at a timecode
LTC, MTC, Art-Net and OSC outputs at 23.976 to 30 fps, drop frame included
Projects saved as .kode files

entries.title: konv is out
items: Video: H.264, HEVC, ProRes, HAP, DNxHR and VP9
Audio: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, AAC and OGG, with loudness normalising
Images and image sequences, plus extracting audio
Presets for media servers, editing, web and show audio
A queue for files and whole folders, with GPU encoding where available

entries.title: dekk is out
items: Library with background BPM, beatgrid, key and waveform analysis
Two or four decks with hot cues, loops, sync and key lock
Four-channel mixer with EQ, filter, crossfader and headphone cue
Prepare view, MIDI learn and recording the mix
OSC beat and BPM out for vyz
